name: chipotle_find_menu_item_price
intent: Find the price of a Chipotle menu item
description: Finds the price of a Chipotle menu item at the preferred pickup location and returns the price shown in the menu.
patterns: find the price of a menu item
how much does a menu item cost
what is the price of this item

inputs.name: menu_item
inputs.description: Menu item whose price should be found.

inputs.name: preferred_zip_code
inputs.description: ZIP code for the preferred Chipotle pickup location.

steps.intent: Scroll until the CHIPS & SIDES category is visible
Open the CHIPS & SIDES category containing {{menu_item}}
Dismiss the location-data dialog blocking the menu
Type {{preferred_zip_code}} into the location search field
Swipe to reveal the list of pickup locations for {{preferred_zip_code}}
Tap a pickup location shown for {{preferred_zip_code}}
Tap PICK UP HERE to select the pickup location and proceed to the menu
